title: Foundation
description: Levelling feet for a base. Set it down on ground no steeper than ten degrees, found the base, and its jacks reach down to hold it level. A founded base can't be pushed or tipped, though whatever hits it can still break it.

title: Base Core
description: The heart of a base: control, a little power in reserve, a few panels on the roof, and room for four. Set it down on a foundation, found it, and build out from its connectors.

title: Habitat Module
description: Living space for six: bunks, a galley, and a window on the world outside. It's brought in on a flatbed and joined at a connector.

title: Propellant Depot
description: Twelve tonnes of propellant in store. It's what a base fills its craft from, and what a tanker tops up.

title: Monopropellant Depot
description: Monopropellant for thrusters, kept in four spheres.

title: Refinery
description: Refines the base's ore and water into propellant and monopropellant, eight times as fast as a craft's converter, for thirty units of charge a second while it runs. Switch it on from the base card.

title: Ore Silo
description: Three thousand units of ore in store (thirty tonnes), for the refinery, or for a tanker to take away.

title: Water Cistern
description: Three thousand units of water in store, for the refinery.

title: Power Module
description: Batteries racked floor to ceiling. They keep a base's lamps lit and its pumps running through the night.

title: Solar Array
description: Two wings of solar cells on a mast, for the top of a module. You get power by day and none by night, so a base wants batteries too.

title: Base Connector
description: A wide hatch for the side of a base module. Bring another module's connector up to it, near enough lined up, and they draw together and join into one base.

title: Corridor
description: A walkway between two modules. Put a connector on each end.

title: Pad Deck
description: A twelve-metre slab to launch from and land on. Founded on its own or joined to a base, it's a launch site. Craft set down on it fill up from the base's stores, and a craft standing on it can be refuelled.

title: Floodlight Mast
description: A six-metre mast with a lamp head, lit at night while the base has power.

title: Flatbed
description: A long low deck on eight wheel mounts, for carrying a module, with a cab at the front and a release clamp in the middle to hold the load and set it down.

title: Release Clamp
description: Holds a load on a flatbed. Stage it and it lets go, staying on the flatbed while the load drops free on its own feet.

title: Sky Deck
description: A twenty-metre deck over a hull of light gas, that floats in the air. With lift fans under its corners and a keeper core, it holds itself where you put it, and founded, it's a base in the sky with a pad on top. Aloft on Caligo, where the ground crushes everything, it's the one place to live.

title: Sea Deck
description: A sixteen-metre deck to stand on four pontoons, for a base afloat, with a pad on top for whatever you fly off it.
